privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
This site collects no personal data about students. There are no accounts, no email addresses, no analytics and no tracking cookies.

Passcode. The passcode you enter is saved only in your own browser so you don't have to type it again. It is sent to our server only to check it.

Bus location. A GPS device on the bus sends its position. Only the latest position is stored — no history of where the bus has been. The position is shown only during service hours and never while live tracking is switched off.

Travel times. To estimate arrival times, the site keeps an average of how long the bus takes between stops, and how many trips that average is based on. Individual trips are not stored.

Map. Map images are loaded from OpenStreetMap, which receives your IP address when loading them, as with any website.

Hosting. The site is hosted on Cloudflare and its data is stored with Supabase in the EU.

admin.switch.title: Live tracking
admin.switch.isOn: On: students can see the bus during service hours.
admin.switch.isOff: Off: students can't see the bus, and its location isn't being recorded.
admin.switch.isOffUntil: Off until {when}: students can't see the bus, and its location isn't being recorded.
admin.switch.resumeAt: If you turn it off, turn it back on automatically at (optional)
admin.switch.help: Use this in an emergency, or when the bus is rented out. Students stop seeing the bus within about 10 seconds.
admin.alerts.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Traffic on the coast road — running about 15 minutes late.
admin.alerts.affectsNone: No runs today to choose from.
admin.hours.title: Service hours
admin.hours.help: The live bus is only shown during these hours. Leave a day empty if there is no service.
admin.tt.help: Optional. Pick a day to see its runs, and tap a run to change it. For each run, tap the stops in the order the bus visits them and type the time at the first stop. The other times are estimated from the travel times further down, and you can type over any of them.
admin.tt.empty: No timetable entered. Students see the live map and service hours instead.
admin.tt.daysHelp: This run happens on every ticked day. Changes apply to all of them.
admin.tt.stops: Stops: tap them in the order the bus visits them
admin.tt.estimateHint: Grey times are estimates from the travel times. Type over one to set it yourself.
admin.tt.errStops: The highlighted run needs at least two stops.
admin.tt.unsaved: You have unsaved changes — press “Save timetable”.
admin.tt.confirmClear: Delete every run in the timetable?
admin.tt.errNoDays: The highlighted run needs at least one day.
admin.tt.errFirstTime: Type the time at {stop} for the highlighted run.
admin.tt.errOrder: In the highlighted run, the time at {stop} is earlier than at the stop before it.
admin.pass.studentHelp: After changing it, ask the registrar to send the new passcode to students. The old one stops working immediately.
admin.pass.adminHelp: Your own login passcode. Keep it private.
admin.pass.tooShort: Use at least {n} characters — a few words works well.
admin.travel.title: Travel times
admin.travel.help: How many minutes the bus takes from one stop to the next. These are used to estimate times in the timetable. Once the tracker has timed a trip {n} times, its average replaces your number.
admin.travel.measured: Measured: about {min} min, from {count} trips. This is in use.
admin.travel.measuring: Measured {count} of {n} trips so far. Your number is in use.
admin.travel.notMeasured: Not measured yet. Your number is in use.
admin.travel.invalid: {from} → {to}: enter minutes from 1 to 180, or leave it empty.
admin.blocks.none: No networks are blocked for wrong passcodes.
admin.blocks.some: {n} network(s) blocked after too many wrong passcodes (for example a dorm's Wi-Fi). Blocks lift by themselves within 10 minutes.
